title: Norpro Plastic Funnel, Set of 3, Set of Three, White
description:
About this item
Every home and kitchen will benefit from having these handy funnels that come in 3 different sizes! Large Mouth: 4"/10cm Stem: .5"/1.25cm; Medium Mouth: 3.5"/9cm Stem: .4"/1cm; Small Mouth: 2.5"/6cm Stem: .3"/.75cm.
A simple, yet helpful tool for transferring liquids/dry ingredients from containers to bottles while keeping the kitchen counter free from spills.
Each funnel has a perfectly narrow spout which fits into a majority of bottle necks, to avoid spilling.
Easy to store, can nest or has convenient loops on the side to hang in garages, kitchens or utility rooms. Great for auto care, cleaning, restaurants, schools and labs!
Top rack dishwasher safe.

Let’s be real: funnels aren’t exactly the life of the party, but when you need to pour, they’re the dependable friends who never let you down. This set has all the sizes you could ever need—small for those tricky spice jars, medium for your average mess, and large for when you're feeling ambitious (or just have a really big jug of something).

They may lack the pizzazz of a glittery cocktail shaker or the charm of a fancy wine aerator, but they get the job done without fuss. Made of durable plastic, these funnels are easy to clean and won’t judge you when you pour pancake batter at 2 AM because breakfast for dinner is always a solid choice.

And let’s not forget their superpower: preventing spills! Whether you’re filling a bottle or transferring liquids from one container to another, these funnels catch every drop like a seasoned pro. reviews_1s:
Hi. I bought this product several years ago. Very pleased with that version. Still in use today.
I just bought a new set as these funnels are very useful.
Disappointed.
The product is supposed to be made from food grade plastic. I have no doubt it is however the inside of the 2 smaller funnels were not smooth as you would expect from food grade. If these were used with a food product, I suspect a problem could occur regardless of care taken to clean them.
Result - relegated the current purchased set to the garage for non food use.I do not know who packed this but a bag of fine thistle bird seed will not mix well with other items with pointy edges. Technically, the seed is all there. It's just all over this box. The bag had a huge rip in it. Take your time, pack boxes well. Each product are good, they just don't play well together.There is a hole in the stem of the largest funnel. It is broken.It broke immediately after using it.I bought these to use for sifting dry bulk ingredients (varying flours, sugar, corn meal, salt, etc) into smaller bottles & containers. These funnels are dismal.

The openings on all of them, even the largest funnel, are too small to allow dry ingredients to sift through without building up in the funnel, including fine salt. You can only put in a bit of ingredients at a time... a Tlbs not whole scoop, even though the largest funnel could accommodate that volume.

This is good for pouring liquids only & even then, if using a thick olive oil, you must go slowly as it backs up quickly as well, only allowing through a bit at a time. The hole is the same circumference the entire length & it's too small for anything to be useful.

Skip them. It was more of a bother & gas money to return, so since they were less than $4, I just kept them & use them gingerly, lest I spill my pricey ingredients. I'm moving soon & these will the 1st items I discard.

0* out of 5.
Buy anything else & ensure the funnel holes are large enough to actually funnel. This might be a product best bought in person.Super thin plastic that is bumpy on the inside and not smooth. Not worth it.My problem with these is that they arrived with some kind of gritty substance on the 2 smallest funnels, which, if unable to remove, would make it impossible for anything to flow through. No way to tell if it was a manufacturing problem, but I was unable to even scrape off whatever it was. Note that these can’t be returned unless defective, which mine were, so Amazon did refund, thankfully. The other problem is that these are extremely small funnels with a tiny opening, much smaller than they appear online, and seem very cheaply made. Really surprised Norpro, which I’ve always liked, would offer such a thing.DIDNT REALLY WORK THAT WELLThese are NOT worth the money. Over $6 and they are thin cheap plastic. I went to Walmart and for 97 cents they had a set of 2 that were far thicker and nicer.The two smaller funnels had very rough unfinished interior surfaces. I returned them and ordered a replacement set which also had the exact same defect in the two smaller funnels. Don't waste your time with these.
